name: delegate_task
description: Hand a task to another agent in a new chat of this machine that the person sees, nested under this chat, and can open, watch and take over. Use it for another provider or model than yours (e.g. Codex, or a stronger or cheaper model), for long work the person should be able to follow or continue, or work to run beside yours. For a quick subtask of your own kind inside this session, use your own subagents instead. The task must stand alone: the other agent sees nothing of this chat. Returns the chat's id at once; the agent works on it meanwhile — wait_conversation for its answer, or notify: true to be woken with it.

provider.description: The agent CLI to run the task.

agent_model.description: A model id of that provider on this machine (as its model picker names it, e.g. opus or sonnet for Claude); omit for the machine's default. An unknown id is refused with the list of the ones there are.

model.description: Deprecated, use agent_model. Claude Code replaces a parameter named exactly `model` with its own subagent model (CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL) before the call leaves it, so a model asked for here may not arrive; agent_model is never touched. When both are given, agent_model is used.

effort.description: Reasoning effort; omit for the model's own.

prompt.description: The task, complete: goal, context, files, what to answer with.

cwd.description: Absolute folder to work in, inside this chat's folder or one of the machine's projects; omit for this chat's folder.

title.description: A short name for the chat, as the person sees it in the sidebar.

notify.description: Wake this chat with the result when the other agent finishes a turn (it arrives as a message from that agent). Default false.

test.description: Mark the chat as a test chat: the person's sidebar leaves it out (they can show test chats). Set it for a chat you start only to check something. Default false.

name: read_conversation
description: Read a chat you delegated: the person's and the agent's messages, tool calls in a line each (failed ones with their output), oldest first. Ends with a cursor: pass it as since to read only what came after.

since.description: The cursor of an earlier read.

limit.description: At most this many entries, the latest ones. Default 40.

name: send_to_conversation
description: Give a chat you delegated more work, an answer or an instruction, as a message from your agent (never as the person's words). An agent that works gets it inside its running turn, at its next step (the person may have set «after the turn» for this machine); a free one starts on it at once. The answer says what happened: delivered into the running turn, delivered, or queued and why. A queued message is not lost and is typed once: do not send it again.

deliver.description: now: urgent — it goes into the running turn and the tool the agent runs is handed to the background, so it is read at once; use it for a change of plan the agent must not work past. queue: it waits for the agent's turn to end; use it for work to pick up after the current one. Omit for the machine's default (into the running turn, read at the agent's next step).

name: wait_conversation
description: Wait until a chat you delegated finishes what it was last given (or needs the person, or stops), at most timeout_s seconds, and get its last answer. A timeout means it still works: wait again or read it.

timeout_s.description: How long to wait. Default 120; Codex's calls end at 55.

name: list_children
description: The chats this chat delegated, with each one's agent, model and state.
